2401.05630v1.title: New candidate hypervelocity red clump stars in the inner Galactic bulge

evidence.quote: In total, we found 69 candidate HVSs pointing away from the Galactic centre with transverse velocities larger than the local escape velocity.
65 were detected only in the VIRAC2 sample
